item.title: Hug-a-Bye Baby (Davis) — Wed Sep 2, 10:30 AM — Blanchard Room
item.description:
Join us for a lap-sit program for babies ages 0 to 18 months and their caregivers followed by a Stay-and-Play. We will share songs, lullabies, fingerplays, and board books!
The program is held indoors, in the Blanchard Room and is offered in two-month sessions. Each session is limited to 30 families.
This program is offered by registration only. In addition, all babies must have a Yolo County library account.
The July/August Session is currently full. You can register for the September / October Session here.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Pokémon Club — Wed Sep 2, 2:00 PM — *Children's Activity Room
item.description:
Welcome trainers, to Pokémon Club! Pokémon club meets every Wednesday to share in the love of Pokémon. Come participate in activities and learn to play the trading card game, and even take down powerful Pokémon in Raids! Materials are provided. Participants may bring their own deck, but we recommend you leave your most precious cards at home.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Davis Origami Group (Davis) — Wed Sep 2, 6:00 PM — Blanchard Room
item.description:
Come fold with the Davis Origami Group! All ages and skill levels are welcome. Young folders who need assistance should be accompanied by someone who can help them. The first half hour is for beginning folders and the last hour is for intermediate folders.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Drop-In Libby Help (Davis) — Wed Sep 2, 6:30 PM — Mary L Stephens Davis Branch Library
item.description:
Stop by during this drop-in session to learn how to download and read/listen to e-books and e-audiobooks through Libby. Bring your library card and phone, tablet, or laptop.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Mother Goose on the Loose! (Davis) — Tue Sep 1, 10:00 AM — Blanchard Room
item.description:
Join Ms. Sue for Mother Goose on the Loose!
Mother Goose on the Loose is an award-winning early literacy program for toddlers (ages 2-3) and their grown-ups. It combines music, movement, rhymes, and books to help young children develop language skills, social and emotional skills, general knowledge about the world, and a love of learning.
Every Tuesday in the Blanchard Room of the Mary L. Stephens Davis Branch Library.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Davis Farmers Market - Every Saturday from 8am - 1pm — Sat Oct 17, 1:00 AM — Central Park
item.description:
Experience the heart and soul of Davis every Saturday at the Davis Farmers Market in Central Park! 🗓 Every Saturday⏰ 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM📍 Central Park, Davis Shop fresh from the source with local farmers and vendors offering: 🥕 Fresh, seasonal produce🌻 Farm products🛍 Handmade crafts🥖 Fresh-baked goods☕ Coffee and hot food Whether you’re stocking up on locally grown ingredients, enjoying breakfast in the park, or simply soaking in the vibrant community atmosphere, the Davis Farmers Market is a beloved weekly tradition for all ages. Bring your family, support local growers and makers, and enjoy the bounty of our fertile region every Saturday!
Source: Davis Downtown

item.title: Phonebank for Randy Villegas en Español — Wed Aug 5, 5:30 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
Únete al equipo de campaña de Villegas para el Congreso en nuestras sesiones de llamadas a votantes de los miércoles a las 5:30-7:30 pm. Llamamos a los votantes del Distrito 22 para ganar su apoyo para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre. Cada sesión comenzará con un breve entrenamiento sobre el uso de nuestro sistema de llamadas y para revisar del guion. No te preocupes si nunca has hecho esto antes; nos aseguraremos de que te sientas cómodo con todo el proceso antes de empezar a llamar. ¡Acompáñ
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Phonebank for Randy Villegas! — Thu Aug 6, 5:30 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
Join the Villegas for Congress team for our Thursday phonebanks. We'll be calling voters in District 22 to earn their votes for the November 3rd election. Each phone bank will begin with a training on how to use our phonebanking system and to review our script. If you have never phonebanked before that’s okay, we'll make sure you’re comfortable with everything before we start calling. Please join us and bring a friend! Únete al equipo de campaña de Villegas para el Congreso en nuestras sesiones

Every Wednesday evening through August 26, the market expands to 4:00 – 8:00 PM, turning Central Park into the perfect spot for a relaxed picnic dinner. Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead! Each week features live music and children’s activities, creating a festive, family-friendly atmosphere. Bring blankets, lawn chairs, and reusable bags. It’s the ideal way to unwind, connect with neighbors, and support local farmers and food makers. This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary!
